# Models

OpenField does not ship model weights. It drives a ComfyUI install that has them,
and its graphs resolve models **by filename** — so a file has to keep the exact
name in the tables below, in the folder shown, or the render fails.

## Getting them

```bash
npm run models -- --list          # what you have, what you are missing
npm run models                    # the core install
npm run models -- --only h3       # one bundle
npm run models -- --all           # everything, optional included
```

The installer needs `COMFY_MODELS_DIR` pointing at your ComfyUI `models/`
folder, and `HF_TOKEN` for the gated repos. Downloads resume, so an
interrupted 21 GB pull does not start over.

The core install is **LTX-2.5 video + Qwen-Image stills**, about 
**72 GB**. Everything here is about 334 GB.

## Bundles

### LTX-2.5 video `ltx25`

Video + Loop modes on the LTX-2.5 engine. The recommended starting point: it is the only video engine here whose license permits commercial delivery, and its first/last-frame mode closes seamless loops without a post dissolve.

- **Size** 39.8 GB · part of the core install
- **License** LTX-2.x Community License Agreement (Aug 11, 2026). Free for any use, commercial included, if you (and your affiliates) earn under $10M a year; at $10M or more a paid Commercial Use Agreement is required for anything beyond non-commercial use. Acceptable-use restrictions apply. The Gemma 4 based text encoder ships in this repo under the same license.

### Upscale: Sharpen `upres`

Sharpen mode of the Upscale app: a 4x ESRGAN pass downsampled to a clean 2x, optional RIFE frame doubling, original audio kept. The default model is RealESRGAN x4plus. Needs two custom node packs as well as the weights.

- **Size** 0.1 GB · optional
- **License** RealESRGAN x4plus (the default): BSD-3-Clause, Xintao Wang et al. (github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN); the file fetched here is byte-identical to the v0.1.0 GitHub release (sha256 4fa0d389...682f1). RIFE 4.7 (rife47.pth, fetched by Frame-Interpolation on first use): MIT. Node packs: VideoHelperSuite GPL-3.0, Frame-Interpolation MIT.
- **Custom nodes** [ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite) — provides `VHS_LoadVideo`
- **Custom nodes** [ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation](https://github.com/Fannovel16/ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation) — provides `RIFE VFI`

### Upscale: Redraw (SeedVR2) `seedvr2`

Redraw mode of the Upscale app: SeedVR2 one-step diffusion restoration rebuilds real detail at a 1080 or 1440 short edge, on video or stills. 3B is the fast default, 7B adds detail. Needs the SeedVR2 custom node pack, which also reads its weights from models/SEEDVR2/.

- **Size** 23.8 GB · optional
- **License** SeedVR2 weights: Apache 2.0, ByteDance Seed (huggingface.co/ByteDance-Seed/SeedVR2-3B and -7B, github.com/ByteDance-Seed/SeedVR); the fp16 repackage fetched here (numz/SeedVR2_comfyUI) is Apache 2.0 too. Node pack ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler (numz): Apache 2.0. VideoHelperSuite: GPL-3.0.

### Upscale: Dream `dream`

Dream mode of the Upscale app: LTX-2.5 encodes the clip, its latent upsampler doubles it, and the distilled model re-imagines the detail from a prompt. Uses the ltx25 weights; only needs VideoHelperSuite on top.

- **Size** 0 GB · optional
- **License** LTX-2.x Community License Agreement (the ltx25 bundle): free for any use, commercial included, under $10M yearly revenue. VideoHelperSuite: GPL-3.0.

### Mirror (motion transfer) `mirror`

Mirror mode: a source clip becomes a pose, depth or edge control track (comfyui_controlnet_aux preprocessors, which fetch their own small detector weights on first use) and the LTX IC-LoRA Union Control re-renders it on LTX-2.5. Needs the ltx25 bundle.

- **Size** 0.7 GB · optional
- **License** IC-LoRA Union Control: LTX-2 Community License Agreement (same $10M revenue threshold as LTX-2.5). Pose: DWPose + YOLOX weights, Apache 2.0. Depth: Depth Anything V2 Small (depth_anything_v2_vits.pth), Apache 2.0, fetched by controlnet_aux on first use. Edges: Canny, no weights. Node packs: comfyui_controlnet_aux Apache 2.0, VideoHelperSuite GPL-3.0.
- **Custom nodes** [comfyui_controlnet_aux](https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux) — provides `DWPreprocessor`
- **Custom nodes** [ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite) — provides `VHS_LoadVideo`

### Reshoot (new camera angle) `reshoot`

Reshoot mode: re-render a clip from a new azimuth / elevation. MoGe-2 estimates metric geometry, the CrossView Warp node reprojects the clip into the new camera, and the CrossView-Warp v2 IC-LoRA re-renders it on LTX-2.5. Needs the ltx25 bundle and three custom node packs.

- **Size** 1 GB · optional
- **License** CrossView-Warp v2 LoRA: labelled Apache 2.0 by its author (training renders used CC-BY / CC0 assets, see its ATTRIBUTION.md), but it is an LTX-2.3 adapter and the LTX license requires derivatives to be distributed under LTX terms, so treat it as LTX-2 Community License. MoGe-2 weights: MIT. Node packs: ComfyUI-CrossViewWarp Apache 2.0, ComfyUI-LTXVideo LTX-2 Community License, VideoHelperSuite GPL-3.0.
- **Custom nodes** [ComfyUI-CrossViewWarp](https://github.com/cseti007/ComfyUI-CrossViewWarp) — provides `CrossViewWarp`
- **Custom nodes** [ComfyUI-LTXVideo](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo) — provides `LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly`
- **Custom nodes** [ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite) — provides `VHS_LoadVideo`

### Effects (Lightricks LoRAs) `effects`

The Effects app, Lightricks set: Cutout (alpha matte), Flood (add water), Nightfall (day to night), Empty the scene (clean plate) and Living photo (cinemagraph). ### Cast in video (Ingredients IC-LoRA) `cast`

Cast members in Video and Director shots: their pictures are laid out on a reference sheet that LTX-2.5 holds on every frame through the Ingredients IC-LoRA, so faces, costumes, props and places stay the same across shots. Without it, Cast falls back to a hero frame from the edit bundle. Needs the ltx25 bundle. The repo is gated: accept its license on Hugging Face first.

- **Size** 1.3 GB · optional
- **License** LTX-2.x Community License Agreement (Aug 11, 2026), the same terms as LTX-2.5: free for any use, commercial included, under $10M yearly revenue.

### Stage look frames (Z-Image Turbo + depth) `stage-look`

The look frame for a Stage shot: Z-Image Turbo with the Fun ControlNet Union reads an exact depth pass of the blocking, so the art-direction frame keeps the set where it was blocked. ## Other weights for the same model

Each model family loads its files through named slots. A slot can take another
file of the same model, for example a fine-tune or a different quantization, by
setting its variable in `.env`. The value is the name exactly as ComfyUI lists it
in that loader. A file in a subfolder keeps the subfolder, and ComfyUI on Windows
writes it with a backslash:

```
OPENFIELD_LTX25_TRANSFORMER=ltx25\my-ltx25-finetune-fp8.safetensors
```

Restart OpenField after a change. Setup and `npm run doctor` then check for the
configured file in place of the stock one, and `npm run models` never downloads
a configured file: put it in the folder yourself. Variables left unset keep the
stock file. A render that fails in a node loading a configured file names its
slot and the file.

LoRAs are made for the stock files. For LTX-2.5 that includes the IC-LoRAs of
Effects, Mirror, Reshoot, Cast, Stage and HDR; a model with LoRAs merged in can
behave differently under them, so try each app you use. `npm run workflows`
always writes the stock names.
